messages:
Aisha (CSM): Kicking off onboarding for ArtemisIQ — pilot goal: embeddings + chat live in 30 days. Quick sync Thurs 11am PT to assign owners and surface major risks. Link to kickoff doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/artemisiq.
Priya (Kapella): Thurs ok for us. I'll invite Ravi (ML lead) and Nora (Ops). Success criteria from our side: 1) embeddings eval >= 88% on our labeled set, 2) chat p90 latency < 400ms for short queries, 3) VPC integration validated for prod data.
Matt (Solutions): Noted. I'll prepare the integration checklist and a demo client. Decision: start hosted for fast iteration, switch to Dedicated if throughput/privacy requires.
Jordan (Eng): For sizing autoscaling, what's avg query length and peak QPS during pilot?
Priya (Kapella): Avg ~60 tokens, peak ~30 QPS, steady ~5. We'll provide a test corpus by Friday.
Tom (Product): Renewal note: if pilot shows <3% regression vs baseline and infra cost below their target, sales will accelerate contracting. Marking as a renewal signal.
Aisha (CSM): Adding renewal signal to success metrics. Enablement asks: ML training session, KV caching runbook, SRE handoff doc.
Matt (Solutions): Proposed timeline:
Week 1: access, keys, data pull, dev kickoff
Week 2: embeddings eval + baseline, dev integration, observability dashboard start
Week 3: chat integration, latency tuning, tracing + token cost charts
Week 4: pilot validation, security review, go/no-go and handoff
Priya (Kapella): Can observability be earlier? We want cost + latency dashboards ready by end of week2.
Jordan (Eng): Yes, we'll spin dashboards in week2. I'll add tracing events and token-level metrics. Send the list of events to instrument.
Aisha (CSM): Risks: data access delays, noisy labels in eval set, EU egress constraints. Priya, if EU egress is required we may need Private — how long to validate?
Matt (Solutions): Private setup + VPN/KMS validation usually 3-4 weeks. If EU compliance mandatory, escalate now.
Aisha (CSM): Action items: Priya -> contact list + test corpus by Fri; Matt -> integration checklist; Jordan -> observability templates; Tom -> renewal metric tracking. I'll send calendar invite and update kickoff doc.
onboard-bot: Onboarding kickoff checklist created: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/checklists/1747654321 — please update status.
Priya (Kapella): Thanks. Can we schedule a 30m enablement for Product leads after week2 demo?
Aisha (CSM): Yes, scheduling a 30m enablement session post-week2. :thumbsup:
Matt (Solutions): I'll prepare a short deck on quantization & batching best practices.
Jordan (Eng): Ping me if you need sample logs for tracing tests.
Aisha (CSM): Great — see you Thurs. If anything blocks before then, post here or DM.
